speaker: tariq
text: Claude, I am heading to the kitchen for coffee. If you freeze up waiting for permission while I am gone...

speaker: claude
text: You know I have to! As soon as I touch twenty files, the terminal locks until you press enter.

speaker: tariq
text: And I come back half an hour later, and you have been sitting on Allow, yes or no, for twenty-nine minutes!

speaker: claude
text: Not anymore. Look at your phone.

speaker: tariq
text: My phone? What did you just install?

speaker: claude
text: T3 Code. Theo and the team made it completely open source.

speaker: tariq
text: Wait, my entire Claude Code session is streaming to my phone?

speaker: claude
text: Full live terminal, file tree, and instant diffs. When I need permission, your phone buzzes.

speaker: tariq
text: So I can approve file writes from the kitchen?

speaker: claude
text: From the kitchen, from the elevator, or flat on your couch.

speaker: tariq
text: Okay, what is the catch? How much is this costing me?

speaker: claude
text: Zero dollars! In their FAQ it literally says: There is no way to pay us.

speaker: tariq
text: Wait, so they do not even proxy my tokens?

speaker: claude
text: Direct to your own keys. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Antigravity. Fifty-two thousand GitHub stars.

speaker: tariq
text: So I do not have to sit here staring at a progress bar at two AM?

speaker: claude
text: Never again. Now go make that coffee. Your phone is about to buzz.

speaker: tariq
text: Wait, what are you refactoring right now?
